programStructure.heading: How the ProCoding Works
programStructure.subheading: We’ve designed the learning journey so you never feel lost — every step builds your skills and confidence.

steps.title: Start strong with guidance
steps.text: Before the bootcamp starts, you’ll get access to prep materials and an onboarding session. We’ll help you set up your dev environment and explain what to expect from the course.

steps.title: Learn by doing
steps.text: Each week combines short theory blocks with live coding. You’ll start coding right away with your instructor and get real-time feedback.

steps.title: Build real projects step by step
steps.text: From small exercises to portfolio-ready apps, everything you code connects to real-world developer tasks. By the end, you’ll have projects to showcase to employers.

steps.title: Code Review & Personalized Feedback
steps.text: Senior mentors review your code, highlight strengths, and point out improvements. You’ll learn industry best practices the way real dev teams work.

steps.title: Teamwork & Collaboration
steps.text: Midway through the program, you’ll join group projects using Git, task boards, and peer review — simulating real-world team workflows.

steps.title: Career coaching built-in
steps.text: You’ll work  with career mentors: polishing your resume, LinkedIn, and GitHub. You’ll do mock interviews and get personalized feedback.

steps.title: Final Project & Graduation
steps.text: In the last weeks, you ship a capstone project — a complete app built from scratch. Graduation isn’t the end: we continue supporting you in your job search until you land your first role.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We’ve gathered answers to the most common questions our students ask before starting. Didn’t find what you need? Message us — we’re happy to help.
faq.q1: Is the bootcamp suitable if I’ve never written code before?
faq.a1: Yes! The program is designed for beginners. We start from the basics and gradually move to more complex topics. All you need is the motivation to learn and dedicate time to practice.
faq.q2: How much time do I need to study each week?
faq.a2: On average, 15–20 hours per week. It’s manageable alongside work or school if you plan your time well.
faq.q3: What if I don’t understand something in class?
faq.a3: You’ll always have access to session recordings, plus support from mentors and coordinators who will help you figure things out.
faq.q4: What kind of projects can I show to employers?
faq.a4: By the end of the course, you’ll have a portfolio — from your personal website and simple apps to a full-fledged team project and a final capstone project.
faq.q5: Will you help me get a job?
faq.a5: Yes. We’ll help you prepare your resume, LinkedIn, and GitHub, run mock interviews, and connect you with partner companies. Our support continues even after graduation.
faq.q6: How is this bootcamp different from free courses?
faq.a6: The key difference is a structured curriculum, mentors, teamwork, and career support. It’s not just a collection of lessons — it’s a path from zero to your first tech job.
faq.a7: Live online sessions with mentors + hands-on practice. You’ll code alongside instructors, get real feedback, and work on real projects.
faq.q8: Can I join from any country?
faq.a8: Yes, the program is fully online and follows EST time zone. All you need is a computer and a stable internet connection.
faq.a9: We’ll keep supporting you in your job search until you land your first IT job. Plus, you’ll gain access to our alumni community and career resources.
faq.q10: How do I know which course is right for me — WebDev, QA, or AI?
faq.a10: We’ll schedule a consultation and help you choose a program based on your goals, background, and ideal career path.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
curriculum.subtitle: We’ve designed this bootcamp to be intensive, yet perfectly paced for beginners. Every week, you’ll receive theoretical lessons on the platform, get clear explanations from experts during live classes, and join live coding and code-along sessions. You will also put your knowledge into action during pair programming labs — because we believe the best way to learn is by doing.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We’ve gathered answers to the most common questions our students ask before starting. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Just message us — we’re here to help.
faq.a1: The course lasts 6 months. Classes take place two evenings a week and on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, all online. This flexible format makes it easy to combine learning with your job and personal life.
faq.a2: It’s designed for beginners, career changers, self-taught learners who need structure, and recent graduates looking to get job-ready skills.
faq.a3: You’ll master HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and more — along with modern tools and workflows. You'll also learn agile methodologies like Agile, Scrum, and Kanban.
faq.q4: Is it all theory, or will there be hands-on practice?
faq.a4: There’s a lot of practice! After every module, you’ll complete lab assignments and mini-projects. At the end of the course, you’ll build a team project for your portfolio.
faq.q5: What will I have by the end of the course?
faq.a5: A professional portfolio with 2–3 projects, Junior+ level web development skills, a polished resume, LinkedIn profile and interview readiness.
faq.q6: Do you help with job search?
faq.a6: Yes! Our career team helps you every step of the way — from writing your resume and preparing for interviews to connecting you with partner employers.
faq.q7: Is there support during the course?
faq.a7: Absolutely. You’ll be guided by mentors, instructors, and technical assistants. You can always ask questions and get help with any topic or technical issue.
faq.q8: What if the format doesn’t work for me?
faq.a8: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you realize the course isn’t the right fit within the first month, we’ll refund your payment.
faq.q9: What is the class format like?
faq.a9: Classes are fully online and use interactive formats — live coding, code-alongs, challenges, discussions, and stand-ups. No boring screen shares — only engaging, hands-on learning.
